answer: Draft a honeypot task with an answer already known to be wrong. Split it across three auditors drawn from unrelated subnetworks, so one operator cannot fill the quorum. Score down any auditor that approves the trap. Reject a submission whose support sits inside a single canyon of the peer graph. The cost is scale: a farm must seed distinct agents in separate regions, keep a tundra of dormant accounts warm, and still survive a spiral of traps it cannot recognize.
